messages.subject: error bars not dodged
parts:
Dear ggplot-ters,

I have a rather simple problem. When plotting a bar chart the error bars are all mapped to the same x coordinate. I understand they need to be dodged, and when I do this it works. However I want to add some annotation to the top facet of the plot and to do this I have used geom_text and have created a data frame ('nd') with the required text. If the fill = Group mapping aesthetic is included in the initial ggplot call then I get the error:

Error: Aesthetics must either be length one, or the same length as the dataProblems:week, titre_2_AnnNS_T2, Text

I have experienced this before and understand that it is because the aesthetics of nd need to be the same length as those of the original call. I can get around this by moving the 'fill = Group' mapping code from the ggplot aesthetics to the aesthetics of the specific geom_bar. But when I do this (as in the code below) the error bars become un - dodged.

I have included a MRE below.

Any help most appreciated.

Best wishes,

Felix



# create df for annotation text
nd <- data.frame(week = c(0, 4, 11),
titre_2_AnnNS_T2=c(90, 90, 90),
sample=factor(c("Neut-NS"), levels = levels(DVCT_sum4$sample)),
Text=c("P", "B", "C"))

# error bars correctly dodged, but geom_text wont work

p <- ggplot(data=y, aes(x=week, y = titre_2_AnnNS_T2, fill = Group)) +
geom_bar(stat="identity", position = position_dodge(2)) +
geom_errorbar(aes(ymin=titre_2_AnnNS_T2-se, ymax=titre_2_AnnNS_T2+se), position=position_dodge(2), width=0.4, size =0.3)+
xlab("Week") + ylab("1 / titre") +
scale_fill_discrete("Group", breaks=c("1", "2", "3", "4", "5"), labels=c("1:atAlHV-1 + Em", "2:atAlHV-1 + Fli-C", "3:atAlHV-1 + \nEm + Fli-C", "4:Em", "5:Fli-C"))
p

# geom_text will now work, but error bars become un-dodged:

p <- ggplot(data=y, aes(x=week, y = titre_2_AnnNS_T2)) +
geom_bar(aes(fill = Group), stat="identity", position = position_dodge(2)) +
geom_errorbar(aes(ymin=titre_2_AnnNS_T2-se, ymax=titre_2_AnnNS_T2+se), position=position_dodge(2), width=0.4, size =0.3)+
xlab("Week") + ylab("1 / titre")


p <- p + facet_grid(sample ~., labeller = trial_labeller, scales ="free")
p
p <- p + geom_text(aes(week, titre_2_AnnNS_T2, label=Text), size =2, data=nd)
p

messages.author: ec77c1435314684c
messages.subject: Re: error bars not dodged
parts:
Hi Felix,

I've come across this too. I'm not sure why, but adding `fill = Group` to the mapping for the error bars will fix the dodging. Maybe one of the experts can chime in as to why this is the case, but meanwhile here's one possibility, using your 'y' data.frame:

library(ggplot2)
library(plyr)


# map the levels of y$Group
y$Group <- mapvalues(y$Group, from = c("1", "2", "3", "4", "5"),
                     to = c("1:atAlHV-1 + Em", "2:atAlHV-1 + Fli-C", "3:atAlHV-1 + \nEm + Fli-C", "4:Em", "5:Fli-C"))


# set the position dodge
pd <- position_dodge(2)


g <- ggplot(y, aes(x = week, y = titre_2_AnnNS_T2)) +
  geom_bar(aes(fill = Group), stat = 'identity', position = pd) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(fill = Group, ymin=titre_2_AnnNS_T2-se, ymax=titre_2_AnnNS_T2+se),
                position = pd, width = 0.4, size = 0.3) +
  facet_grid(sample ~., scales ="free") +
xlab("Week") + ylab("1 / titre")

# create df for annotation text
nd <- data.frame(week = c(0, 4, 11),
                 titre_2_AnnNS_T2=c(90, 90, 90),
                 sample=factor(c("Neut-NS"), levels = levels(y$sample)),
                 Text=c("P", "B", "C"))

g + geom_text(aes(x = week, y = titre_2_AnnNS_T2, label = Text), size = 2, data=nd)

I used plyr to rename the factor levels in Group but your way with `scale_fill_discrete` works too.

Cheers,

Tom
